## Plugin reference

- Description: Every web list the main composition declares, as the build wrote it (webLists: id, declaring plugin, key, meta) — the declared half of the list catalog, read by the server, which cannot see web slots (reorder registers a config directive per reorderable list). A child of its own so only its readers re-key when a list is declared.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `reorder`
- Core:
  - Exports (values): `webLists`
